params.description:
`page.activity` parameters: whether the page is visible and when it last got the focus. The companion sends
`open.requested` to the page that reported the latest focus (a visible one first); a page that never reported is
never sent one.

focusedAt.description: When the page last got the focus (ms since the epoch).

params.title: PageActivityParams

summary: The page tells whether it is visible and when it last got the focus; `open.requested` goes to the page with the latest focus, and never to one that did not report.
